description: Hello! I am a first-year undergraduate student studying Artificial Intelligence at the E-Just / El Sewedy University of Technology in Egypt, with a strong passion for space exploration, technological innovation, and data storytelling. Our project, "Forgotten Space Heroes," focuses on reviving the untold stories of historic space missions—starting with the legendary Sojourner rover—to inspire children aged 8 to 16. We are looking for collaborative team members with skills in programming,
